advanced-filter-description: E faatagaina e le Faamama Maualuga le tusia o se manoa o loo iai nei faagaoioiga: == != <= >= && || ( ) E faaaoga se avanoa e tuueseese ai Faagaoioiga. E mafai ona e faamama Fanua Patino uma i le taina o o latou igoa ma tau. Mo se faataitaiga: Field1 == Value1. Manatua: Afai e iai avanoa i fanua po o tau, e tatau ona siomia i faailoga upu tasi. Mo se faataitaiga: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ina ia faamisi mataitusi pule tasi (' \/), e mafai ona faaaoga \. Mo se faataitaiga: Field1 == I\'m. E mafai foi ona tuufaatasi ni aiaiga se tele. Mo se faataitaiga: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. E masani ona faamatalaina faagaoioiga uma mai le agavale i le taumatau. E mafai ona sui le faasologa i le tuuina o puipui. Mo se faataitaiga: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). E mafai foi ona saili fanua tusitusiga i le regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Faapipii se JSON auina atu a Kanboard: se mea faitino e iai "columns" (po o galuega o loo iai column_name) ma se faasologa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). E avea columns ma lisi ma tasks ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-deck: Faapipii se JSON o le laupapa NextCloud Deck (se laupapa e iai "stacks", ma stacks taitasi e iai ana "cards"). E avea stacks ma lisi ma cards ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Faapipii se JSON o le aoina o work-packages a OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). E avea statuses ma lisi ma work packages ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Faapipii se faasologa JSON o issues a __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). E avea issues ma pepa ua faavasega i lisi Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Faapipii se JSON auina atu o tasks a Asana ({ "data": [...] } mai le auina atu a Asana po o GET /tasks). E faavasega tasks i sections (memberships); o tasks ua maea e alu i Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Faapipii se JSON auina atu o le lisi ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). E avea stages ma lisi ma items ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Pipii se lisi galuega markdown (masani lea o loʻo faʻaaogaina e meafaigaluega markdown-kanban e pei o le Obsidian Kanban): ulutala "## Igoa o le lisi", faatasi ai ma mea "- [ ]"/"- [x]" i lalo. E avea ulutala ma lisi ma avea mea ma kata.
import-board-instruction-leo: Faapipii se fausaga Leo (se faila .leo). O vaega i le tulaga pito i luga e avea ma lisi, o vaega o loo i lalo tonu o ia vaega e avea ma pepa, ma o tusitusiga o le vaega e avea ma faamatalaga o le pepa. O vaega i tulaga e sili atu ona loloto e avea ma lisi siaki. O vaega ua faailogaina e aumai o ni vaega ua maea.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Faapipii se faila todo.txt: tasi le galuega i laina ta'itasi, e pei ona tusia e le polokalame todo.txt ma isi polokalame e fetaui i ai. O galuega ua mae'a ("x") e alu i le vaega Ua mae'a, o +project ma @context e avea ma faailoga, o (A) e avea ma faailoga o le faamuamua, ae o due: ma t: e avea ma aso e tatau ona mae'a ai ma aso e amata ai.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Faapipii le iʻuga o le task export: se faasologa JSON po o se galuega e tasi i laina taʻitasi. O galuega ua maeʻa e alu i Done, project ma priority e avea ma igoa faailoga, annotations e avea ma faamatalaga, ma depends e avea ma faalagolago i galuega o loo poloka ai.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Tatala le faila .boardarchive mai le zip ma faapipii le anotusi o le board.jsonl o le laupapa, faatasi ma le laina o le lomiga pe aunoa ma lea laina. O le uiga e tuufaatasi ai vaega i le vaaiga o le laupapa e avea ma lisi, o isi uiga filifilia e avea ma igoa faailoga, o poloka o tusitusiga ma pusa faailoga e avea ma faamatalaga ma se lisi siaki, ma e teu pea manatu faaalia. E lē faaulufaleina ata ma faila faaopoopo.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: E mafai ona faamaoti ni faagaoioi se tele.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
O faagaoioi tutusa e tuufaatasia i le *OR*. E toe faafoi pepa e fetaui ma soo se tuutuuga.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e toe faafoi pepa o loo i soo se lisi e igoa *Blocked* po o *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: O faagaoioi eseese e tuufaatasia i le *AND*. E na o pepa e fetaui ma faagaoioi eseese uma e toe faafoi. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e toe faafoi na o pepa i le lisi *Available* e iai le igoa faailoga *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: E mafai ona faamaoti aso i se numera atoa lelei po o le lelei-lēai, pe faaaoga `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` po o `__predicate_year__` mo le vaitaimi o loo iai nei.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: I le tulaga faaletonu, e lē sailia pepa ua teuina.

s3-force-path-style-description: E manaomia e MinIO ma le tele o sapalai e fetaui ma S3 ae lē o AWS.
azure-connection-string-description: Filifiliga: faaaoga se manoa fesootai atoa nai lo le igoa ma le ki o le teugatupe.
database-migration: Siitaga o le nofoaga o faamatalaga
database-migration-description: Siitia faamatalaga tusitusia (mea uma vagana faapipii ma ata o tagata, e tumau i le faiga faila) i le va o MongoDB ma FerretDB v1 (SQLite). E tatau ona ola ma mafai ona fesootai le isi nofoaga o faamatalaga (uafu faaletonu: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; sui i WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). A mae'a, faasino MONGO_URL i le isi nofoaga o faamatalaga ma toe amata WeKan (i le Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb po o =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Siitia faamatalaga tusitusia i FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopi faaputuga tusitusia uma i __db__? E lē aafia faapipii ma ata o tagata i le faiga faila. E tatau ona ola le nofoaga o faamatalaga taulaiga.
database-migration-done: Ua mae'a le siitaga o faamatalaga tusitusia.
sandstorm-migration-description: Pe a faagaoioi WeKan i totonu o se grain Sandstorm, e siitia lana nofoaga tuai MongoDB 3 i FerretDB v1 (SQLite) i le ulua'i amataga, ma e siitia faapipii ma ata o tagata mai le nofoaga o faamatalaga i faila files/attachments ma files/avatars o le grain. E faaali ai pe na manuia lena siitaga ma le tele o le avanoa i le tisiki o loo faaaoga pea e faila mata MongoDB tuai i totonu o le grain, ma faatagaina oe e soloia na faila mata e faasaoloto ai le avanoa.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: Faila mata o le nofoaga o faamatalaga MongoDB 3
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Soloi faila mata o le nofoaga o faamatalaga MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: A mae'a manuia le siitaga, e iai faamatalaga i FerretDB ma le faiga faila, o lea e mafai ai ona soloia faila mata tuai o le nofoaga o faamatalaga MongoDB 3 e faasaoloto ai le avanoa o le tisiki o le grain. E lē mafai ona toe faafoi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Soloi faila mata o le nofoaga o faamatalaga MongoDB 3 e faasaoloto ai le avanoa o le tisiki? Ua uma ona siitia faamatalaga i FerretDB ma le faiga faila. E lē mafai ona toe faafoi.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Ua soloia faila mata o le nofoaga o faamatalaga MongoDB, ua faasaoloto
features-desc: Tomai e filifili ai ua saunia e WeKan. O le tomai e le'i filifilia e natia mai tagata faaaogā uma. E teu pea ona faamatalaga ma e lē suia faatagaga.
feature-views-table-desc: Le laupapa o se laulau o pepa e mafai ona faavasega.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalena ma le kalena mo laupapa e tele.
feature-views-time-desc: Taimi ma le laina o taimi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Fuainumera, faavasegaina e tusa ma le tagata ua tofia i ai, fuafuaga o galuega, laupapa mataitu ma le laupapa tele.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Vaaiga e tolu o siata Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Galuega o le oloa o loo faatali, vaitaimi pupuu o galuega, lipoti o le vaitaimi ma le saoasaoa o galuega.
feature-views-flow-charts: Siata o le faagasologa o galuega
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Galuega o totoe, galuega ua mae'a, faagasologa ua tuufaatasia, taimi o le taamilosaga ma le taimi mai le talosaga i le mae'a, aofaiga o galuega ua mae'a, taimi ua faatali ai galuega, faalavelave, Monte Carlo ma isi fua o le faagasologa.
feature-views-map-desc: Pepa e pei o faailoga i luga o se ata ua lafo i luga.
feature-awaiting-approval: (fou, o loo faatali mo le faatagaga)
feature-approval-required: Taofi tomai ua faaopoopo i faafouga a WeKan ia lē ola se'ia faaola e se pule
feature-preview-admins: E iloa e pule tomai ua tape ina ia faataitai muamua
feature-pilot-users: Tagata faataitai e iloa foi tomai ua tape
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Igoa o tagata faaaogā, tuueseese i koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Ua sefe. E le'i maua nei igoa o tagata faaaogā:
card-field-visibility-desc: The fields of Board Settings / Card that boards can show. An unticked field is hidden from every card, minicard and Board Settings / Card of every board. No card data or board setting changes, and ticking it again shows each board as it was set. The order of the fields is each board's own.
cards-loading-description: E utaina otometi e WeKan pepa o le laupapa: o se laupapa tele (sili atu i le tapulaa o le telē) e utaina na o pepa o loo vaaia nei (taai e lē gata) faatasi ma se faitauga ola, ina ia vave ma itiiti le manatua ma le bandwidth e faaaoga, ae o laupapa laiti e utaina pepa uma mo se faiga faigofie ma atoatoa. E leai se mea e faatulaga. E mafai pea e pule ona faamalosia se faiga i fesuiaiga o le siosiomaga CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ma CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: O le utaina faatuai o pepa o se su'ega: e sa'o faitauga o pepa ma tapulaa WIP, ae o vaaiga Calendar/Table/Gantt ma le filifiliga-tele e aofia ai na o pepa ua uma ona utaina. Toe uta laupapa tatala pe a suia lenei mea.
render-links-as-plain-text: Faaali sootaga o ni tusitusiga masani
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Pe a mafai, o sootaga uma (sootaga markdown e pei o [label](url) ma pine HTML mata <a href>) e faaali pea o ni tusitusiga masani e lē mafai ona kiliki i fanua tusitusiga teuteu uma (ulutala o laupapa ma pepa, faamatalaga auiliili, faamatalaga, lisi siaki, ma isi). E taofia ai sootaga kiliki e taufaasese. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu, o lea e mafai pea ona kiliki sootaga.
always-show-code-as-text: Faaali pea code uma o ni tusitusiga masani
always-show-code-as-text-description: Pe a mafai, e lē faaliliuina lava tusitusiga teuteu o se markdown po o HTML: e faaali pea le puna atoa o ni tusitusiga masani i fanua tusitusiga teuteu uma (ulutala o laupapa ma pepa, faamatalaga auiliili, faamatalaga, lisi siaki, ma isi). E faaalia ai anotusi nana — faamatalaga HTML (<!-- -->), le taulaiga o sootaga markdown, JavaScript ma soo se isi code — ina ia vaaia pea code uma, e lē mafai ona kiliki, ma e lē faagaoioia. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu, o lea e faaliliuina masani ai le markdown.
disable-all-import-description: Pe a mafai, e tape tomai uma e aumai ai: aumaia o se laupapa mai WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ma Forgejo, faapea le kopiina o se laupapa. E nana filifiliga o le lisi aumai ma e teena e le sapalai soo se talosaga e aumai. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-all-export-description: Pe a mafai, e tape tomai uma e auina atu ai: auina atu o se laupapa o WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, po o le auina i NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ma le auina atu o se faapipii e tasi. E nana filifiliga o le lisi auina atu ma e teena e le sapalai soo se talosaga e auina atu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-import-avatars: Tape le aumaia o ata o tagata
disable-import-avatars-description: Pe a mafai, e lē aumaia lava ata o tagata (ata o talaaga o tagata faaaoga). E aofia ai le aumaia o WeKan JSON, le aumaia o Trello, ma le faafetaui o ata mai auaunaga faailoa i fafo pe a ulufale (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). E aumai pea igoa ma isi faamatalaga; na o ata o tagata e faamisi. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-export-avatars: Tape le auina atu o ata o tagata
disable-export-avatars-description: Pe a mafai, e lē aofia lava ata o tagata (ata o talaaga o tagata faaaoga) pe a auina atu se laupapa (auina atu WeKan JSON ma CSV). E auina atu pea igoa o tagata faaaoga ma isi faamatalaga; na o ata o tagata e aveese. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
anonymize-import-users: Aveese faailoaga o tagata faaaoga e aumai
anonymize-import-users-description: Pe a mafai, o le aumaia o se laupapa WeKan JSON e sui ai igoa o tagata faaaoga, igoa atoa ma mataitusi amata o tagata uma ua aumai i mea suitulaga faitau (user1, user2, ...), aveese a latou ata, ma toe tusia ta'ua @username (ma fanua requested-by / assigned-by) i totonu o anotusi o pepa ma faamatalaga ua aumai. E leai se faailoaga moni o se tagata faaaoga mai le laupapa puna e teuina. O le upu "tagata faaaoga" e mulimuli i le gagana a le tagata o loo aumaia. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
anonymize-export-users: Aveese faailoaga o tagata faaaoga e auina atu
anonymize-export-users-description: Pe a mafai, o le auina atu o se laupapa e sui ai igoa o tagata faaaoga, igoa atoa ma mataitusi amata o tagata uma ua auina atu i mea suitulaga faitau (user1, user2, ...), aveese a latou ata, ma toe tusia ta'ua @username (ma fanua requested-by / assigned-by) i totonu o anotusi o pepa ma faamatalaga. E leai se faailoaga moni o se tagata faaaoga i le faila ua auina atu. O le upu "tagata faaaoga" e mulimuli i le gagana a le tagata o loo auina atu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
anonymize-account: Aveese faailoaga o tagata faaaoga e aumai
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Pe a mafai, o le auina atu o se laupapa e sui ai igoa o tagata faaaoga, igoa atoa ma mataitusi amata o tagata uma ua auina atu i mea suitulaga faitau (user1, user2, ...), aveese a latou ata, ma toe tusia ta'ua @username (ma fanua requested-by / assigned-by) i totonu o anotusi o pepa ma faamatalaga. E leai se faailoaga moni o se tagata faaaoga i le faila ua auina atu. O le upu "tagata faaaoga" e mulimuli i le gagana a le tagata o loo auina atu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-activities-description: Pe a mafai, e lē faamauina lava ma e lē faaalia i soo se mea faamaumauga o le fafaga o gaoioiga (itu lisi o le laupapa ma le laupepa gaoioiga o le pepa). E leai se talafaasolopito o ai na faia le ā e teuina. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-notifications-description: Pe a mafai, e lē auina atu lava e WeKan faasilasilaga mataitu (i totonu o le polokalama, imeli po o isi auaunaga) mo soo se gaoioiga. E mafai pea ona faamauina gaoioiga (seia vagana ua tape foi i luga); na o faasilasilaga e taofia. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-watch-description: Pe a mafai, e tape le tomai mataitu — e lē mafai e tagata faaaoga ona lesitala i laupapa, lisi po o pepa e maua ai faasilasilaga, ma e teena soo se taumafaiga e suia se tulaga mataitu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
backup-description: Fai kopi faaleoleo o Faapipii, Ata o Tagata ma/po o Faamatalaga (faaputuga tusitusia uma e lē o ni faapipii po o ni ata o tagata). E tafe sa'o le .zip i le nofoaga teu filifilia — e leai se faila lē tumau — o backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e aofia ai YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ma /data. O nofoaga teu i le ao (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) e faaaoga faamaoniga ua faatulaga i a latou laupepa teu.
backup-scope-description: O le faiga atoa, po o se Faalapotopotoga e tasi. O le kopi faaleoleo a se Faalapotopotoga e aofia ai ana laupapa ma mea uma o iai, e aofia ai faapipii o na laupapa — ae leai ni teugatupe a tagata faaaoga po o faatulagaga o le faiga, aua e faasoa na mea e Faalapotopotoga uma. O le toe faafoiina o le kopi faaleoleo a se Faalapotopotoga e na o laupapa e ana le Faalapotopotoga e tusia ai.
theme-override-all-tenants: Suiga e faaaoga i tagata nofoia uma
continuous-backup-description: E lafo suiga uma o le nofoaga o faamatalaga, faapipii, ata o tagata ma faamaumauga o galuega i se faila i totonu o ni sekone, ina ia mafai ona toe faafoi i soo se taimi. E galulue faatasi ma le kopi faaleoleo faatulagaina, lea e faia ai kopi atoa.
continuous-backup-enabled: Fai kopi faaleoleo faifai pea i lenei seva
continuous-backup-target: Faila e teu ai (ala atoa, i se isi tisiki, se nofoaga fefaasoaaʻi i le fesootaiga po o se nofoaga ua faapipii i le rclone)
continuous-backup-engine: Afi o le nofoaga o faamatalaga
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (i le taimi lava lea, suiga uma)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Itulau SQLite (itulau ua suia i taimi taitasi ua faatulagaina)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (polokalame e mafai ona e faapipii pe a e finagalo i ai)
continuous-backup-engine-none: E leai se afi o le nofoaga o faamatalaga e mafai ona galue i lenei seva
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Taimi i le va o galuega SQLite (sekone)
continuous-backup-base-every: Fai se kopi faavae fou i itūlā taitasi ua faatulagaina
continuous-backup-encrypt: Faailoga le kopi faaleoleo i se tulafono faalilolilo (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faila o le ki mo le faailoga faalilolilo (ala atoa i fafo o le faila e teu ai; mataitusi e 64 o le faiga numera faavae 16 po o se fuaitau faalilolilo e lē itiiti ifo i le 16 mataitusi). Teu se kopi: a leai lenei faila, e lē mafai ona toe faafoi le kopi faaleoleo.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Leai se nofoaga (na o le faila e teu ai)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Faila i totonu o le pakete e teu ai
continuous-backup-fetched: Ua aumai faila mai le ao
continuous-backup-restore-to: Toe faafoi i (aso ma le taimi)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faila o le nofoaga o faamatalaga SQLite (e fausia i autafa o le kopi faaleoleo, e lē tusia lava i luga o le faila o loo faaaogā)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Faaaogā le nofoaga o faamatalaga SQLite ua toe fausia i le isi toe amataga (e teu pea le nofoaga tuai o faamatalaga ua suia)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Toe faafoi le augatupulaga ua filifilia i le taimi ua filifilia? E taofi lē tumau le kopi faaleoleo faifai pea a o faagasolo le toe faafoi.
continuous-backup-saved: Ua sefe faatulagaga o kopi faaleoleo faifai pea
backup-restore-add-missing: Faaopoopo na o faamatalaga o loo misi
backup-restore-select-first: Filifili muamua se kopi faaleoleo mai le lisi.
backup-restore-confirm: Toe faafoi le kopi faaleoleo filifilia? E tusia faapipii/ata o tagata i le faiga faila ma faamatalaga i le nofoaga o faamatalaga e tusa ma le faiga filifilia.
gcs-key-filename: Ala o le faila ki o le teugatupe tautua
gcs-key-filename-description: Filifiliga: ala i se faila ki JSON o le teugatupe tautua i luga o le sapalai.
gcs-credentials-description: Filifiliga: faapipii le ki JSON o le teugatupe tautua. Tuu gaogao e faaaoga ai le faila ki po o faamaoniga faaletonu.
gcs-permissions-note: Tuu atu i le teugatupe tautua a WeKan le avanoa faitau/tusi i le pakete: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → lau pakete → Permissions → Grant access. I le "New principals", faapipii le imeli o le teugatupe tautua — le tau "client_email" mai lau ki JSON — ona filifili lea o le matafaioi "Storage Object Admin" ma Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tuu gaogao e tausia ai le tau o loo iai nei.
azure-account-name-description: Le igoa o lau teugatupe Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Le koneteina blob e teu ai faila.
gcs-project-id-description: Le id o lau poloketi Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Le igoa o le pakete Cloud Storage e teu ai faila.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tuu gaogao (e faaaoga le nofoaga faaiu o le itulagi). E fetaui ma S3: le Endpoint URL mai lau faamafanafanaga MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → lau pakete → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → igoa o lau pakete (po o Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → lau tagata faaaoga → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → filifili le faaaogaina 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. E faaali o le 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: O le lau lava lea e iai le Access key ID; e na o le tasi le taimi e faaali ai le 'Secret access key' pe a faia le ki — kopi i lena taimi (po o Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → igoa e faaali i luga (e iai foi i Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → Data storage → Containers → lau koneteina (po o + Container e faia ai se tasi).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → filifiliga o le poloketi i luga → ID o lau poloketi (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → igoa o lau pakete (po o Create e faia ai se tasi).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ala i luga o le sapalai WeKan i le faila ki JSON o le teugatupe tautua ua sii mai (na faia i lalo). Faaaoga lenei mea PO O le faapipii o le JSON i le fanua i lalo.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → lau teugatupe tautua → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (e sii mai ai le faila). Faapipii lona anotusi iinei, po o le sefe o le faila ma faatulaga lona ala i luga.

cloud-settings-save-failed: Ua lē mafai ona sefe faatulagaga o le nofoaga teu

attachment-move-storage-gcs: Siitia le faapipii i Google Cloud Storage

migration-paused: Ua manuia le taofia mo sina taimi o siitaga

migration-started: Ua manuia le amataina o siitaga

migration-stop-failed: Ua lē mafai ona taofi siitaga
migration-stopped: Ua manuia le taofia o siitaga
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Ina ia vaaia faapipii ma ata o tagata, siitia mai CollectionFS i se isi Nofoaga Teu.
pause-all-migrations: Taofi mo Sina Taimi Siitaga Uma

s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket name for storing files
s3-enabled-description: Faaaoga AWS S3 po o MinIO mo le teuina o faila

s3-secret-key-description: Ki lilo AWS S3 mo le faamaoniga

schedule-board-backup: Faatulaga le Kopi Faaleoleo o le Laupapa
schedule-board-cleanup: Faatulaga le Faamamaina o le Laupapa
writable-path-description: Ala o le faila autu mo le teuina o faila
card-show-lists-on-minicard: Faaali Lisi i luga o le Pepa Laitiiti
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Faia siaki ma faaleleiga atoatoa mo le sa'o o faamatalaga o le laupapa, e aofia ai le faasologa o lisi, nofoaga o pepa ma le fausaga o ala.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Soloi ma le saogalemu lisi gaogao ua faaluaina. E na o lisi e leai ni pepa MA e iai se isi lisi e tutusa le ulutala ma e iai ni pepa e aveese.

E tumau faaletonu tumau ma feʻau ua oo i le tapulaa o taumafaiga mo le toe iloiloina. O le toe taumafai i feʻau na lē manuia e amata ai se taamilosaga fou o taumafaiga ma e tausisia le taofi mo sina taimi ua iai.

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.

interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
